do"},{"id":"F4:L0012","text":"  command -v \"$tool\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"✓ $tool found\" || echo \"✗ $tool NOT FOUND — install before continuing\""},{"id":"F4:L0013","text":"done"},{"id":"F4:L0014","text":"```"},{"id":"F4:L0015","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0016","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F4:L0017","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0018","text":"If any tool is missing, **STOP** and tell the user which tools to install before continuing."},{"id":"F4:L0019","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0020","text":"## Cluster Connection"},{"id":"F4:L0021","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0022","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F4:L0023","text":"# Confirm active context"},{"id":"F4:L0024","text":"kubectl config current-context"},{"id":"F4:L0025","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0026","text":"# Inventory all nodes"},{"id":"F4:L0027","text":"kubectl get nodes -o wide"},{"id":"F4:L0028","text":"```"},{"id":"F4:L0029","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0030","text":"## GPU Detection"},{"id":"F4:L0031","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0032","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F4:L0033","text":"# Extract GPU count and model per node (requires NVIDIA device plugin labels)"},{"id":"F4:L0034","text":"kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{\"\\t\"}{.status.allocatable['\\''nvidia.com/gpu'\\'']}{\"\\t\"}{.metadata.labels['\\''nvidia.com/gpu.product'\\'']}{\"\\n\"}{end}'"},{"id":"F4:L0035","text":"```"},{"id":"F4:L0036","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0037","text":"> **Note:** The above command relies on `nvidia.com/gpu.product` node labels, which are set by the NVIDIA device plugin or GPU operator. If the output shows empty GPU fields, try the fallback:"},{"id":"F4:L0038","text":">"},{"id":"F4:L0039","text":"> ```bash"},{"id":"F4:L0040","text":"> # Fallback: check node descriptions for GPU capacity"},{"id":"F4:L0041","text":"> kubectl describe nodes | grep -A 5 \"Allocatable:\" | grep -i nvidia"},{"id":"F4:L0042","text":"> ```"},{"id":"F4:L0043","text":">"},{"id":"F4:L0044","text":"> If neither approach shows GPUs but you know the nodes have GPU hardware, the NVIDIA device plugin may not be installed yet. Guide the user to install it before proceeding."},{"id":"F4:L0045","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0046","text":"**Report to user:**"},{"id":"F4:L0047","text":"- Cluster context name"},{"id":"F4:L0048","text":"- Total node count and GPU node count"},{"id":"F4:L0049","text":"- Per GPU type: model, count, VRAM per card, total cluster VRAM"},{"id":"F4:L0050","text":""},{"id":"F4:L0051","text":"**Decision logic:**"},{"id":"F4:L0052","text":"- No kubeconfig context → **STOP**. Tell user to configure `kubeconfig` (e.g., `az aks get-credentials`) and retry."},{"id":"F4:L0053","text":"- No GPU nodes detected → Note \"CPU-only cluster\" and proceed; CPU-only inference is available via KAITO + llama.cpp."}],"source_sha256":"1d8776309855462b47d1094bfef0d02f7105f3d03f6902eea6de0a57636bf94e"},{"file":"references/steps/step-2-controller.md","file_id":"F5","lines":[{"id":"F5:L0001","text":"# Step 2 — Controller Status & Installation"},{"id":"F5:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0003","text":"**Goal**: Ensure the AI Runway controller and CRDs are installed and healthy."},{"id":"F5:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0005","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F5:L0006","text":"# Check CRD presence"},{"id":"F5:L0007","text":"kubectl get crd modeldeployments.airunway.ai"},{"id":"F5:L0008","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0009","text":"# Check controller pod health"},{"id":"F5:L0010","text":"kubectl get pods -n airunway-system -l control-plane=controller-manager"},{"id":"F5:L0011","text":"```"},{"id":"F5:L0012","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0013","text":"**If already installed and healthy:** Report version and pod status, skip to Step 3."},{"id":"F5:L0014","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0015","text":"**If not installed:** Ask user to confirm, then from the **repository root** run:"},{"id":"F5:L0016","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0017","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F5:L0018","text":"make controller-install   # Install CRDs"},{"id":"F5:L0019","text":"make controller-deploy    # Deploy controller manager"},{"id":"F5:L0020","text":"```"},{"id":"F5:L0021","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0022","text":"> **Note:** `make` targets must be run from the AI Runway repository root."},{"id":"F5:L0023","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0024","text":"Verify rollout:"},{"id":"F5:L0025","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0026","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F5:L0027","text":"kubectl rollout status deployment/airunway-controller-manager -n airunway-system --timeout=120s"},{"id":"F5:L0028","text":"```"},{"id":"F5:L0029","text":""},{"id":"F5:L0030","text":"**Error handling:**"},{"id":"F5:L0031","text":"- `CrashLoopBackOff` → `kubectl logs -n airunway-system -l control-plane=controller-manager --previous`"},{"id":"F5:L0032","text":"- Rollout timeout → `kubectl describe deployment airunway-controller-manager -n airunway-system`"},{"id":"F5:L0033","text":"- `No rule to make target` → Navigate to repo root and retry"}],"source_sha256":"5088d7b90881e35db3d2f9d7a128eca6661487924338aaf057cfc22109701e93"},{"file":"references/steps/step-3-gpu.md","file_id":"F6","lines":[{"id":"F6:L0001","text":"# Step 3 — GPU Assessment"},{"id":"F6:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0003","text":"**Goal**: Match detected hardware to known profiles and surface compatibility constraints."},{"id":"F6:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0005","text":"Load and consult [gpu-profiles.md](../gpu-profiles.md)."},{"id":"F6:L0006","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0007","text":"For each GPU type detected in Step 1:"},{"id":"F6:L0008","text":"1. Look up the model in `gpu-profiles.md`"},{"id":"F6:L0009","text":"2. Report: VRAM per card, total cluster VRAM, supported dtypes, recommended attention backend"},{"id":"F6:L0010","text":"3. Surface compatibility warnings:"},{"id":"F6:L0011","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0012","text":"| GPU | Warning |"},{"id":"F6:L0013","text":"|-----|---------|"},{"id":"F6:L0014","text":"| T4 | Does not support bfloat16. Set `--dtype float16` in serving args. |"},{"id":"F6:L0015","text":"| V100 | Does not support bfloat16; limited flash attention. Use xformers backend. |"},{"id":"F6:L0016","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0017","text":"**CPU-only path:** Note CPU-only inference is available via KAITO + llama.cpp. Recommend `google/gemma-3-1b-it-qat-q8_0-gguf`."},{"id":"F6:L0018","text":""},{"id":"F6:L0019","text":"Use the **Model Sizing Guide** in [model-sizing.md](../model-sizing.md) to calculate maximum model size for the cluster."}],"source_sha256":"882f657390c9fc55a87d657da9ac1c6ae18bc0730c0f9d64683d174d7d2892a8"},{"file":"references/steps/step-4-provider.md","file_id":"F7","lines":[{"id":"F7:L0001","text":"# Step 4 — Provider Recommendation & Installation"},{"id":"F7:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0003","text":"**Goal**: Select and install the right inference provider for the detected hardware."},{"id":"F7:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0005","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F7:L0006","text":"# Check if providers are already registered"},{"id":"F7:L0007","text":"kubectl get inferenceproviderconfigs --all-namespaces 2>/dev/null || kubectl get inferenceproviderconfigs"},{"id":"F7:L0008","text":"```"},{"id":"F7:L0009","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0010","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F7:L0011","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0012","text":"**If providers already registered:** Show name and status, skip installation."},{"id":"F7:L0013","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0014","text":"**Provider recommendation logic:**"},{"id":"F7:L0015","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0016","text":"| Hardware | Use Case | Recommended Provider |"},{"id":"F7:L0017","text":"|----------|----------|---------------------|"},{"id":"F7:L0018","text":"| CPU-only | Any | KAITO (llama.cpp) |"},{"id":"F7:L0019","text":"| GPUs | Standard inference (most users start here) | KAITO |"},{"id":"F7:L0020","text":"| GPUs | High-throughput serving with separate prefill/decode phases | Dynamo |"},{"id":"F7:L0021","text":"| GPUs | Already using Ray for ML workloads | KubeRay |"},{"id":"F7:L0022","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0023","text":"> **Default to KAITO** unless the user has a specific reason to choose otherwise. KAITO is the simplest to set up and handles most use cases. Dynamo is for teams that need to independently scale the prefill and decode stages of inference for high throughput. KubeRay is for teams already invested in the Ray ecosystem."},{"id":"F7:L0024","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0025","text":"Present recommendation with reasoning. Ask user to confirm before installing."},{"id":"F7:L0026","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0027","text":"**Installation** — from the **repository root**:"},{"id":"F7:L0028","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0029","text":"First, check the provider's Makefile or README for the default image:"},{"id":"F7:L0030","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0031","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F7:L0032","text":"# List available providers and their default images"},{"id":"F7:L0033","text":"ls providers/"},{"id":"F7:L0034","text":"cat providers/<provider>/Makefile | grep -E 'IMG\\s*\\?='"},{"id":"F7:L0035","text":"```"},{"id":"F7:L0036","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0037","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F7:L0038","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0039","text":"Then deploy:"},{"id":"F7:L0040","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0041","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F7:L0042","text":"cd providers/<provider>"},{"id":"F7:L0043","text":"make deploy IMG=<image>"},{"id":"F7:L0044","text":"```"},{"id":"F7:L0045","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0046","text":"> **Tip:** If the Makefile defines a default `IMG`, you can omit the `IMG=` argument and just run `make deploy`."},{"id":"F7:L0047","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0048","text":"**Verify registration:**"},{"id":"F7:L0049","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0050","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F7:L0051","text":"kubectl get inferenceproviderconfigs <provider> -o yaml"},{"id":"F7:L0052","text":"```"},{"id":"F7:L0053","text":""},{"id":"F7:L0054","text":"Check `status.ready: true`. If not ready within 2 minutes, inspect provider pod logs with `kubectl logs <pod-name>` and optionally use `kubectl describe pod <pod-name>` to review events and pod status."}],"source_sha256":"3a618de715c5594d12ded0e08189cf66843239dc234d86c541df268ac9dcbcff"},{"file":"references/steps/step-5-deploy.md","file_id":"F8","lines":[{"id":"F8:L0001","text":"# Step 5 — First Model Deployment"},{"id":"F8:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0003","text":"**Goal**: Deploy a starter model that fits the cluster's GPU capacity and reach `Ready` status."},{"id":"F8:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0005","text":"**Model recommendations** (based on cluster VRAM from Step 3 — see [gpu-profiles.md](../gpu-profiles.md) for full sizing guide):"},{"id":"F8:L0006","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0007","text":"| Cluster Capacity | Recommended Model | Provider | Notes |"},{"id":"F8:L0008","text":"|-----------------|-------------------|----------|-------|"},{"id":"F8:L0009","text":"| CPU-only | `google/gemma-3-1b-it-qat-q8_0-gguf` | KAITO (llama.cpp) | GGUF Q8 quantized; runs on CPU |"},{"id":"F8:L0010","text":"| 1× T4 (16 GB) | `microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct` | KAITO (vLLM) | Small, fast; fits T4 with headroom |"},{"id":"F8:L0011","text":"| 1× A10G or L4 (24 GB) | `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` | KAITO (vLLM) | Good general-purpose starter (gated — needs HF token) |"},{"id":"F8:L0012","text":"| 1× A100 40 GB | `microsoft/Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct` | KAITO (vLLM) | ~28 GB float16; non-gated; MIT license |"},{"id":"F8:L0013","text":"| 1× A100 80 GB / H100 | `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` | KAITO (vLLM) | Oversized for 8B; suggest 70B with tensor parallelism if more GPUs available |"},{"id":"F8:L0014","text":"| 4× A100 80 GB | `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct` | KAITO (vLLM, tensor parallel) | Large model; requires tensor parallelism; gated — needs HF token |"},{"id":"F8:L0015","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0016","text":"Present recommendation. Ask user to confirm or choose their own model."},{"id":"F8:L0017","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0018","text":"## Naming Convention"},{"id":"F8:L0019","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0020","text":"- **`model-name`**: A DNS-safe Kubernetes resource name derived from the model ID (e.g., `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` → `llama-3-1-8b-instruct`)"},{"id":"F8:L0021","text":"- **`model-id`**: The full HuggingFace model identifier (e.g., `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`)"},{"id":"F8:L0022","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0023","text":"## Gated Models (HuggingFace Token)"},{"id":"F8:L0024","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0025","text":"Llama-family models are gated on HuggingFace and require an access token. Read the token interactively to avoid exposing it in shell history:"},{"id":"F8:L0026","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0027","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F8:L0028","text":"# Read token without echo, store in a securely permissioned temp file"},{"id":"F8:L0029","text":"hf_token_file=\"$(mktemp)\""},{"id":"F8:L0030","text":"trap 'rm -f \"$hf_token_file\"' EXIT"},{"id":"F8:L0031","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0032","text":"read -r -s -p \"Enter HuggingFace token: \" hf_token"},{"id":"F8:L0033","text":"printf '\\n'"},{"id":"F8:L0034","text":"printf '%s' \"$hf_token\" > \"$hf_token_file\""},{"id":"F8:L0035","text":"chmod 600 \"$hf_token_file\""},{"id":"F8:L0036","text":"unset hf_token"},{"id":"F8:L0037","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0038","text":"kubectl create secret generic hf-token \\"},{"id":"F8:L0039","text":"  --from-file=token=\"$hf_token_file\" \\"},{"id":"F8:L0040","text":"  -n <namespace> \\"},{"id":"F8:L0041","text":"  --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -"},{"id":"F8:L0042","text":"```"},{"id":"F8:L0043","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0044","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F8:L0045","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0046","text":"## Apply the ModelDeployment CR"},{"id":"F8:L0047","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0048","text":"Use the appropriate manifest based on whether the model is gated."},{"id":"F8:L0049","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0050","text":"**For gated models (Llama etc. — requires HuggingFace token):**"},{"id":"F8:L0051","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0052","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F8:L0053","text":"kubectl apply -f - <<EOF"},{"id":"F8:L0054","text":"apiVersion: airunway.ai/v1alpha1"},{"id":"F8:L0055","text":"kind: ModelDeployment"},{"id":"F8:L0056","text":"metadata:"},{"id":"F8:L0057","text":"  name: <model-name>"},{"id":"F8:L0058","text":"  namespace: <namespace>"},{"id":"F8:L0059","text":"spec:"},{"id":"F8:L0060","text":"  model:"},{"id":"F8:L0061","text":"    id: <model-id>"},{"id":"F8:L0062","text":"    huggingFaceTokenSecretRef:"},{"id":"F8:L0063","text":"      name: hf-token"},{"id":"F8:L0064","text":"      key: token"},{"id":"F8:L0065","text":"  provider:"},{"id":"F8:L0066","text":"    name: <provider-name>"},{"id":"F8:L0067","text":"EOF"},{"id":"F8:L0068","text":"```"},{"id":"F8:L0069","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0070","text":"**For non-gated models (Phi-3, Gemma etc. — no token required):**"},{"id":"F8:L0071","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0072","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F8:L0073","text":"kubectl apply -f - <<EOF"},{"id":"F8:L0074","text":"apiVersion: airunway.ai/v1alpha1"},{"id":"F8:L0075","text":"kind: ModelDeployment"},{"id":"F8:L0076","text":"metadata:"},{"id":"F8:L0077","text":"  name: <model-name>"},{"id":"F8:L0078","text":"  namespace: <namespace>"},{"id":"F8:L0079","text":"spec:"},{"id":"F8:L0080","text":"  model:"},{"id":"F8:L0081","text":"    id: <model-id>"},{"id":"F8:L0082","text":"  provider:"},{"id":"F8:L0083","text":"    name: <provider-name>"},{"id":"F8:L0084","text":"EOF"},{"id":"F8:L0085","text":"```"},{"id":"F8:L0086","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0087","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F8:L0088","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0089","text":"## Monitor Deployment"},{"id":"F8:L0090","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0091","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F8:L0092","text":"kubectl get modeldeployment <model-name> -n <namespace> -w"},{"id":"F8:L0093","text":"```"},{"id":"F8:L0094","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0095","text":"Wait until `STATUS = Ready`. If not ready within 10 minutes:"},{"id":"F8:L0096","text":"- `kubectl describe modeldeployment <model-name> -n <namespace>` — check events"},{"id":"F8:L0097","text":"- `kubectl get pods -l modeldeployment=<model-name> -n <namespace>` — check pod status"},{"id":"F8:L0098","text":""},{"id":"F8:L0099","text":"> **Note:** Large models (13B+) may take significantly longer than 10 minutes because weights must be downloaded first. For 70B models, expect 20–40+ minutes depending on network speed. Check pod logs to confirm download progress rather than assuming failure."}],"source_sha256":"14ce2057fbeb21d419fd0d9ebba00e42305dbbb959d595d18e55dc1fdeb43179"},{"file":"references/steps/step-6-summary.md","file_id":"F9","lines":[{"id":"F9:L0001","text":"# Step 6 — Summary & Smoke Test"},{"id":"F9:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0003","text":"**Goal**: Confirm everything is working and guide the user on next steps."},{"id":"F9:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0005","text":"Report:"},{"id":"F9:L0006","text":"- Cluster context and node inventory (Step 1)"},{"id":"F9:L0007","text":"- Controller version and namespace (Step 2)"},{"id":"F9:L0008","text":"- GPU types and constraints in effect (Step 3)"},{"id":"F9:L0009","text":"- Provider installed and registration status (Step 4)"},{"id":"F9:L0010","text":"- Model deployed and endpoint URL (Step 5)"},{"id":"F9:L0011","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0012","text":"## Smoke Test"},{"id":"F9:L0013","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0014","text":"Retrieve the endpoint and test it (only after `STATUS = Ready`):"},{"id":"F9:L0015","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0016","text":"> Replace `<namespace>` with the namespace used during deployment (default: `default`)."},{"id":"F9:L0017","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0018","text":"```bash"},{"id":"F9:L0019","text":"ENDPOINT=$(kubectl get modeldeployment <model-name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.status.endpoint}')"},{"id":"F9:L0020","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0021","text":"if [ -z \"$ENDPOINT\" ]; then"},{"id":"F9:L0022","text":"  echo \"Endpoint not yet available — model may still be starting\""},{"id":"F9:L0023","text":"else"},{"id":"F9:L0024","text":"  curl -X POST \"${ENDPOINT}/v1/chat/completions\" \\"},{"id":"F9:L0025","text":"    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\"},{"id":"F9:L0026","text":"    -d '{\"model\": \"<model-id>\", \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Hello!\"}]}'"},{"id":"F9:L0027","text":"fi"},{"id":"F9:L0028","text":"```"},{"id":"F9:L0029","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0030","text":"> **If the endpoint is a cluster-internal URL** (e.g., `http://svc-name.namespace:port`), set up port-forwarding first:"},{"id":"F9:L0031","text":">"},{"id":"F9:L0032","text":"> ```bash"},{"id":"F9:L0033","text":"> # Discover the service port (vLLM: 8000, llama.cpp: 8080)"},{"id":"F9:L0034","text":"> SERVICE_PORT=$(kubectl get svc <service-name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].port}')"},{"id":"F9:L0035","text":">"},{"id":"F9:L0036","text":"> kubectl port-forward svc/<service-name> 8080:${SERVICE_PORT} -n <namespace> &"},{"id":"F9:L0037","text":"> # Then use http://localhost:8080 as the endpoint"},{"id":"F9:L0038","text":"> ```"},{"id":"F9:L0039","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0040","text":"> See [powershell-notes.md](../powershell-notes.md) for the PowerShell equivalent."},{"id":"F9:L0041","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0042","text":"**Expected output:** A JSON response with a `choices` array containing the model's reply."},{"id":"F9:L0043","text":""},{"id":"F9:L0044","text":"**Suggest next steps:**"},{"id":"F9:L0045","text":"- Open the AI Runway Web UI to browse and deploy additional models"},{"id":"F9:L0046","text":"- Configure an ingress gateway for external access"},{"id":"F9:L0047","text":"- Review `controller/config/samples/` for advanced ModelDeployment options"}],"source_sha256":"fe7c9a47b2786b4eaefef1f3cc08fc6d11925fe9514610b72b7f41ceed7a39e7"},{"file":"references/troubleshooting.md","file_id":"F10","lines":[{"id":"F10:L0001","text":"# Troubleshooting & Rollback"},{"id":"F10:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F10:L0003","text":"## Error Handling"},{"id":"F10:L0004","text":""},{"id":"F10:L0005","text":"| Error / Symptom | Likely Cause | Remediation |"},{"id":"F10:L0006","text":"|-----------------|--------------|-------------|"},{"id":"F10:L0007","text":"| No kubeconfig context | Not connected to a cluster | Run `az aks get-credentials` or equivalent |"},{"id":"F10:L0008","text":"| `make: *** No rule to make target` | Not in AI Runway repo root | `cd` to repo root and retry |"},{"id":"F10:L0009","text":"| Controller in CrashLoopBackOff | Config or RBAC issue | `kubectl logs -n airunway-system -l control-plane=controller-manager --previous` |"},{"id":"F10:L0010","text":"| Provider not ready | Image pull or RBAC issue | `kubectl describe pod` for the provider pod |"},{"id":"F10:L0011","text":"| ModelDeployment stuck in Pending | GPU scheduling failure or provider not ready | `kubectl describe modeldeployment` events |"},{"id":"F10:L0012","text":"| Pod shows ImagePullBackOff | Wrong image reference or missing pull secret | `kubectl describe pod` for the model pod |"},{"id":"F10:L0013","text":"| 401 from HuggingFace at model load | Gated model, token secret not wired into CR | Ensure `huggingFaceTokenSecretRef` is set in the CR |"},{"id":"F10:L0014","text":"| `bfloat16` errors at inference | T4 or V100 lacks"}],"source_sha256":"59371f62e15f840c9fc3fdb68adcc8166106431f002beb3d6edeb294bdaa203c"}],"protocol_version":"phase4-discovery-line-id-v1"}
